note: Santa Barbara County park on Lake Cachuma off Hwy 154. Several hundred basic, lake-view and hookup sites, plus yurts, cabins and group camps. The lake is a drinking-water supply, so no swimming or other body contact with the water. Boats need a mussel inspection. Coin showers, store, marina and seasonal pool. --Claude
summary: County pages (browser) and the Camava engine read: $30-55, $10 reservation, $15 extra vehicle, 8 people, 14 nights in 30, 6 months out, year-round. Lakefront kept on the south-arm 'Waterfront' sites that sit at the full-pool line (with caveats). The pin is at the front gate and should move ~360 m to the campsite centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' kept, with caveats. The engine sells 33 'Waterfront - Campsite' sites ($45 lake-view class, bookable by the night). Most sit on bluffs 5-8 m above the full-pool line, which is a view. For example: 414 (34.582327,-119.960519) is at 239 m with the 230.6 m line ~35 m out down a steep bank; 401 (34.581543,-119.961002) is the same; 311 (34.578199,-119.962004) and 315 (34.578183,-119.962447) are 236 m, 20-25 m out; 230 (34.575651,-119.954841) is 239 m, 20 m out. The south-arm group the map labels 'Subject to Flooding in Winter' sits at the full-pool line itself: 562 (34.569747,-119.951448) 230.4 m, 563 (34.569902,-119.951223) 230.7 m, 584 (34.571006,-119.949528) 230.6 m, and 585 (34.570706,-119.949882) 232.3 m at 25 m over open grass. CDEC high water is ~754 ft (NGVD29, ~230.6 m NAVD88). Caveats: the lake is 741.6 ft now (2026-11-25), which puts water 100+ m from these sites in the imagery, and they flood when the lake is full. Swimming and any body contact with the water are banned, though boating is allowed. Proposed evidence: 'Camava site points + 3DEP: south-arm Waterfront sites 562/563/584/585 sit at or within 2 m of the ~754 ft full-pool line, over open grass (map: Subject to Flooding in Winter); the bluff-top Waterfront sites (395-455, 309-318, 230-234) are 5-8 m above it, a view; seasonal, the lake drawn ~4 m below full in Nov 2026'.

PIN: 34.57450,-119.95850 is the front gate (the engine's 'Front Gate' label is 34.57467,-119.95815). Move it to the centroid of the 251 RV-usable site points, 34.57757,-119.95732 (~360 m). The hookup loops (sites 125-157) centre on 34.57582,-119.95688.
